schema.name: alert
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE alert (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, grp TEXT NOT NULL, rule_key TEXT NOT NULL, fp TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, grp, rule_key, fp)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: handoff
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE handoff (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updates TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, seq)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: meta
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE meta (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, k TEXT NOT NULL, v TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, k)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: rule_group
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE rule_group (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, spec TEXT NOT NULL, not_before INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, name)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: self
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE self (one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1), name TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: timeline
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE timeline (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, monitor TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant, monitor)) WITHOUT ROWID

schema.name: viz_schema
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE viz_schema (one INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (one = 1), component TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, compat INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
